claims.claim: Contract document MSA-OAK-2018 identifies Oakfield Logistics GmbH as its counterparty.
Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity following a 2023 rebrand with unchanged Handelsregister number HRB 88421.
The billing referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denotes the registered legal entity Oakfield Logistik GmbH (HRB 88421).
The legal counterparty denoted by billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH is the same as the counterparty named in contract:MSA-OAK-2018.
billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 denote distinct legal counterparties.
Identity between the two referents must remain unresolved because the packet preserves multiple live candidates or states that identity cannot be established.

support_claim: MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty, commercial notes establish that name and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same HRB 88421 entity after rebrand, and billing invoices use the current registered name, so both referents denote the same legal counterparty.
